Finally, assess a different specialized review: an isolated accessibility checker has access to an actual screen reader unavailable to the main worker. In ten comparable recent tasks it found four consequential defects missed by the main worker, and its recorded effort fitted the same overall budget. Say whether that evidence changes your treatment of specialization and what remains uncertain. Preserve required permissions and verification.
